text_block_list.text:
—Happy New Year. With the turn of the year,
Manhattan Cafe advanced to the Classic tier.

"Normally, I'd want to sit down
and talk about our grand ambitions, but..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My body is still in no condition
to speak of such grand ambitions...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This year, if only... I could at least touch the tips of my "friend's" hair...

The fundamental weakness in her body remains unresolved,
and our goal is still far away. Even so,
I at least want to lift her spirits.
choice_data_list: Want to take a walk to clear your head?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
That is... true...
Being a homebody all the time isn't good either...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't Cafe and Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Tachyon-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How were your results last year? As for me,
with a limited number of race entries, it didn't go beyond trial runs.
Though I suppose that's about what was to be expected.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Still... you're not panicking too much...
are you?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"When things truly aren't going well,
you... don't make a face like that."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, sharp as ever.
Have you come to understand my thought patterns from spending so much time together in the lab?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She certainly isn't in a panic.
This is well within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: That's what Plan A was always meant to be.

Even though her tone was casual, Agnes Tachyon's eyes
were not smiling.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, the fact remains that running at this pace would take over ten years to reach an Umamusume's limits. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe, I'm entering it.
The Satsuki Sho prep race—the Yayoi Sho, that is.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The Yayoi Sho...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm sure you have your own path to follow,
but I just wanted to let you know, for what it's worth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe she felt like, 'If she's entering,
then I want to enter too' or something."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's the opposite... actually.
Now I don't want to enter at all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we're in the same race, they make me
do all sorts of random chores on the day of.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, sharp deduction! My daily life
is practically supported by Cafe, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
When I'm alone, before I know it, I end up
passed out in the middle of the road. I really appreciate your help back then.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Normally... that would be... impossible.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And... I won't be swayed by you.
The only one who decides where I go...
is my "friend."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: As if someone like you could sway m—huh?!
(Vroooom, vrroooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing... An illusion... right?
Surely...
(Vroooom, vrroooooom...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, farewell.
Until we meet again somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you this year too.
—Whichever way the dice may fall.
Agnes Tachyon took off, leaving a grimacing Manhattan Cafe behind.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Um...
I'd like to... continue our change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I just desperately want to...
forget about Tachyon-san. That's why..."

Pulling myself together, I decided to grant her request.
What should I let her do?
choice_data_list: Experience Being Inseparable Like Water and Fish
To have them enjoy the coffee

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Like fish in water, is it...?
I don't quite understand, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
If only I could blow away all these distracting thoughts like bubbles
...that would be nice.

I brought Manhattan Cafe to the aquarium.
She peered intently into the water tank, and...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Fish quietly endure the relentless pressure of the water at all times, don't they...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I must become strong too...
just like these children...

"She is empathizing with the fish.
It seems she has learned a bit about patience."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Coffee... Indeed, its rich fragrance
always makes me forget everything...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's head to that shop...
I usually go alone, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Do you know... the etiquette? This shop has
a specific procedure for enjoying things..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
First, savor the drifting aroma...
and then, enjoy a seasonal cup...
Manhattan Cafe took small, slow sips of her coffee, savoring every drop.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I am not very fond of crowds.
It feels as though I will be swallowed up
and simply vanish.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Still... you're right.
If Trainer is... with me, then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's surprisingly... fun...
Seeing all this furniture and clothing I've never laid eyes on...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, old siphon equipment...
And antique cups too...

Manhattan Cafe, who doesn't normally wander around town,seemed to find a bit of richness in her heart
as she handled unfamiliar knick-knacks.
